content: HAEN GAMAG IMUP̱A AMU KOBOL NAU KUḎUM BEḴU
Amge na doye, gog tak haen imup̱a amu ug naunab beḵu.

Danab ag aḵa aḵa ahilagnuib oolag mauhḵu, ag men doḏonuib oolag mauhḵu. Ag aḵa beḏulag humana, enaen mak kobol henana, laa aon aon aqaglag. Geha ag anilḵad mamelḵad oḏelag tabap̱eg neebeb, ag anen anen ag anilḵad mamelḵad dilag ele, “Ena hen meḏap̱ig,” ii doomna. Ag op̱ia awak ii oimna.
Ag tiilag laip̱u ele layam ena iiṯa, ag op̱oḏi bak kobol ii uumna. Ag dimugnu nai mauhnoak maṯiglag, ag oolagp̱anu hak tutuḵu amu atog ii nomana, daḵuḏ kobol henana, ag kobol enanu kekeḏ daaglag.
Ag kadoi layag kekeḏp̱a mak, ahilag dab mak nau paha dim lamiṯak, ag aḵa aaḵuib danab oḵai dooglag. Geha ag beḏunu gamag ahak diigdiig amunuib oolag mauhaha, Kayaknu amu oolag ii mauhma.
Ag Kayaknu kobol amu gaḏalagp̱aib, danab amelagnuib, heḵulag amge Kayak kobolnu g̱agaṯag amu, ag di meṯaglag. Na danab amu dilagnu qe mena oiye!

Danab amunu laala ag haen oh qinonob ah dab mak tutuḵu iiṯa ele amu, ag laulḵadp̱a tena, ham bup̱ualadna heeg, ah amu ag oop̱a genab doyaknu ibp̱a ii oiṯeb. Ah amu ag beḏunu oo gamag ahak ameg qaknu hip̱uninp̱a daaṯeb. Ahilag dab mak eheḏ eeḏaṯe, ag eheḏp̱anab daaṯeb.
Ah amu ag haen oh ip̱uniṯak nai dooglagnu heṯeb amge ag nai genab aoglagnu elele iiṯa.
Anuḵa Janis Jambris ele a Moses kekeḏ medapiḏ bia, danab amu heṯeb ele, ag am nai genabnu kekeḏ daaṯeb. Dab mak ahilag aaḵu nauhom, ahilag oop̱a genab doyak amu ham bup̱uakib.
Am ahilag kobol amu ele oḵai ii mema. Ahilag dab mak, anuḵa danab ag Janis Jambris ele dilah kobol kaaka amu miag atiak anidp̱ig amubia dab mak nau amu danab oh noolagp̱a miag atiak daaḵu.
TIMOTIUS NUG KAYAKNU NAI, OOP̱A AḎAḴUNU NAI

Amge na da ele oiḏa, da danab amelagp̱a nai imu maṯiyi, oh doon malame. Na dahil oiyak doome, dahil kobolnu diig ele doome. Da Kayaknu oolp̱a genab g̱agaṯag dooṯem, amu da haen oh ool g̱agaṯag qedeṯe uḏat hein, da oo mauhak doyen, ug ele mawewe, g̱agaṯag daami amu na amu ele dooṯem.
Amu danab ag Antiok, Aikoniam, Listra ap̱a dahilp̱a kobol nau kuḏum hena, guiṯak meḏan, geḏilna lamiḏp̱ig, keeke amu ohnu amu na doome. Amge na dooṯem, ug amu ohp̱a Naḏi Nug da ehaniḏe, iiṯa meum.
Amu aun laa oh ag Kristus Jesus ele ou qena, Kayaknu kobol meup̱a oiglagnu oolag daaṯe ele amu, ag ug kuḏum aoglag.
Amge danab nau, ham bup̱uak aḏi ele, ag kobol nau henana, tuḏidna naunab henana, ag laa ham bup̱ualaṯegeg, laa amu ag ele ag ham bup̱ualadḵulag.

Amge nahipnu amu na Kayak nai, nai amuam na doyak ena ip̱uniṯa heeb, na Jesusnu ootp̱a genab dooḵutnu elele daaṯe, na nai amu nid nakok daanna, dig men doona, na aun aḏi ag nai diig tutuḵu ele ip̱uniṯeg, na amunu ootp̱a g̱agaṯag genab dooṯem, ag ele doyadṯem amunu na amu dab menan, aḏi keeke ip̱unidp̱ig ele, nai amu aḏan oiye!

Kayak Nug he, nuhig nai aaḵu beum amu nai amu oh ig ehanigṯe. Aṯemun ehanigṯe? Ig amup̱a doyak aoṯem. Ig hip̱unin heḵunig dayeb amu ig daug batak megaṯe. Ig ena ii oignig dayeb amu ib tutuḵu ip̱unigṯe amu ig Kayak noobp̱a ena daagnignu ib ele ip̱unigṯe.
Diig amup̱a ig Kayaknu danab amu ig uḏat ena oh heḵunignu aaḵu elele daaṯem.
